results.title: Jan ƙafa kan matsalar sauyin yanayi ya ɗora duniya kan tafarkin durƙushewa - Guterres
results.content: Babban sakataren Majalisar Dinkin Duniya Antonio Guterres ya shaidawa shugabannin ƙasashe cewar jan ƙafar da ake yi a kan matsalar sauyin yanayi ya ɗora duniya kan tafarkin durƙushewa, kuma dole ne a ɗauki matakin gaggawa don dakatar da hakan.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: An bankaɗo yadda aka aikata laifuka 109 da suka ci karo da yarjejeniyar zaman lafiyar zaɓe
results.content: A Najeriya kwamitin zaman lafiya na ƙasa ƙarƙashin jagorancin tsohon shugaban ƙasa Abdussalami Abubakar ya yi gargaɗi kan yiwuwar fuskantar rikicin zaɓe bayan bankaɗo yadda aka aikata laifuka aƙalla 109 waɗanda ke cin karo da yarjejeniyar zaman lafiyar da aka ƙulla da nufin tabbatar da sahihin zaɓe a baɗi.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: ECOWAS za ta fara amfani da katin shaidar ɗan ƙasa na zamani a kan iyakokinta
results.content: Ƙungiyar raya tattalin arziƙin ƙasashen Afrika ta Yamma wato ECOWAS ta amince da fara karɓar katin shaida na zamani wato Biometric Identity Card a dukkanin iyakokin ƙasashe mambobinta daga ranar 1 ga watan Junairun shekarar 2027.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Mutane sama da milyan uku suka halarci ibada da Fafaroma Leo a Argentina
results.content: A ziyarar da Fafaroma Leo XIV ya kaddamar zuwa yankin Latin Amurka,a yau laraba,ya jagoranci ibada a Argentina,inda akala aka samu mutane sama da milyan uku da suka halarci ibadar ƙarshe yan lokuta kafin Fafaroma ya cira zuwa Peru,ƙasa ta karshe a wannan ziyara a yankin.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Adadin mutaen da suka harbu da cutar Ebola ya haura 11,000 a Congo
results.content: Alƙaluman mahukunta a Jamhuriyar Dimokraɗiyyar Congo sun nuna cewar adadin mutanen da suka harbu da cutar Ebola, ya zarce 11,000, yayin da mutanen da suka mutu sanadiyyar kamuwa da cutar suka kai 5,387.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Ghana ta gano wata katafariyar rijiyar mai a gaɓar ruwan Tano Basin
results.content: Shugaban Ghana John Dramani Mahama ya sanar da gano wata katafariyar rijiyar mai a gaɓar ruwa Tano Basin, bayan share tsawon lokaci ana gudanar da binciken haɗin-gwiwa tsakanin wani kamfani mai suna Planet One Oil and Gaz da kuma GNPC da ke wakiltar ƙasar.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Miliyoyin ma'aikatan Spain sun tsunduma yajin aiki karon farko cikin shekaru 14
results.content: Miliyoyin ma'aikatan Spain sun tsunduma yajin aiki a yau Laraba, wanda shi ne karo na farko cikin shekaru 14, inda suke neman ɗaukar mataki kan matsalar tsadar gidajen haya da kuma tsadar rayuwa.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: INEC ta fara faɗakar da masu buƙata ta musamman kan ƴancin kaɗa ƙuri'a
results.content: Hukumar zabe mai zaman kanta a Najeriya wato INEC Ta Fadakar da Masu Bukata Ta Musamman Kan ƴancinsu na kaɗa Kuri’a. Hukumar ta yi wannan faɗakarwa ne a Yola duba da yadda wasu ke ƙauracewa rumfunar zaɓe saboda wasu dalilai.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Ra'ayoyi kan takun-saƙar EU da Nijar kan batun jibge dakarun Algeria a Yamai
results.content: An shiga takun-saƙa tsakanin Kungiyar Turai da mahukuntan Jamhuriyar Nijar, bayan da ƙungiyar ta ce tana buƙatar ƙarin bayani a game da yarjejeniyar tsaro da aka ƙulla tsakanin Nijar da Aljeriya.

results.title: Hare-haren da aka kai da jirage marasa matuƙa sun kashe yara 410 a Sudan - MDD
results.content: Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ta ce kashi daya cikin uku na yaran da aka kashe ko jikkata a Sudan cikin wannan shekara sun mutu ne saka makon harin da aka Kai da jirage marasa matuka.

results.title: Jagoran adawar Gambia ya sanar da takararsa a zaɓen shugaban ƙasa
results.content: Jagoran adawar Gambia Ousainou Darboe ,ya sanar da anniyarsa ta tsayawa takara nema shugaban ƙasa a zaɓen Disamba wanan shekara ƙarkashin inuwar jami’iyyar UDP.

results.title: Yadda aure ke nesanta mata da gidajen iyayensu
results.content: Shirin rayuwata na yau ya mayar da hankali ne a kan yadda aure ke tilasawa mata da dama yin rayuwa nesa da gidajen iyayensu ko garinsu ko kuma ƙasarsu baki ɗaya.

results.title: Rikici ya tilasta mutum dubu 64 ƙetara wa Nijar daga Najeriya a wannan shekarar
results.content: Hukumar kula da ƴan gudun hijira ta Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ta ce kusan mutane dubu 64,000 ne suka ƙetara Nijar daga arewacin Najeriya cikin wannan shekara ta 2026, saboda rikice-rikice.

results.title: Amurka ta zaftare yawon dakarunta da ke Birtaniya saboda barazanar Iran
results.content: Amurka ta soma kwashe dakarunta a sansanin Royal Air Force da ke Birtaniya saboda barazanar kai hari daga Iran.

results.title: APC ta ƙaddamar da kundin manufofinta na zaɓen shekarar 2027 da ke tafe
results.content: Jam’iyyar APC mai mulki a Najeriya ta ƙaddamar da sabon kundin manufofinta na zaɓen shekarar 2027, inda ta bayyana tsare-tsaren da take son aiwatarwa.

results.title: Nijar ta gayyaci wakilin EU a ƙasar kan zargin yi mata katsa landan
results.content: An shiga takun-saƙa tsakanin gwamnatin mulkin sojin Nijar da ƙungiyar Tarayya Turai EU a gefe guda da kuma Aljeriya a ɗaya gefen tun bayan wasu kalamai da babban jami’in diflomasiyyar ƙungiyar ya yi a kwanan baya inda ya bukaci Aljeriya ta fito ta yi mata karin haske dangane da dalilin jibge wani bangare na dakarunta a arewacin Jamhuriyar Nijar.

results.title: Dakarun Ivory Coast da Gabon da kuma Faransa na gudanar da atisayen soji
results.content: Dakarun ƙasashen Ivory Coast da Gabon da kuma Faransa sun ƙaddamar da wani gagarumin atisayen soji na haɗin gwiwa mai taken FANGHA 2026 a ƙasar Ivory Coast.
